description.text: There are 18 professors, 16 associate professors, 4 doctoral supervisors, 31 master's supervisors, 37 doctors, 1 selected into the National Millions of Talents Project, 1 Minister of Education Jiang Scholar, 1 Zhejiang "10,000 Talents Plan", 1 Zhejiang "Thousand Talents Plan", and 1 chief expert of Zhejiang Industrial Electrical Industry Cluster. The existing national and local joint engineering laboratory of electrical digital design technology, Zhejiang Provincial Engineering Laboratory of electrical digital design technology, mechanical engineering user-side photovoltaic microgrid engineering research center, Zhejiang Province Key Laboratory of Low-voltage Electrical Intelligent Technology, Zhejiang Province Low-voltage Electrical Appliance Technology Innovation Service Platform, Zhejiang Province Low-voltage Electrical Appliance Industry Technology Innovation Strategic Alliance, Zhejiang Province Key Science and Technology Innovation Team of Low-voltage Electrical Appliance Technology for Smart Grid, Zhejiang Province Coastal Engineering Special Power Supply Technology Innovation Team, Zhejiang Province Key Discipline of Universities, The most important disciplines and characteristic majors of the school. It has characteristics in special power supply, smart appliances, microgrid and other aspects. In recent years, he has presided over more than 40 major national science and technology projects, national development and reform commission projects, national natural science foundation of China and provincial major science and technology projects. He has won 1 first prize and 1 second prize of Science and Technology Progress Award of the Ministry of Education, 4 provincial and ministerial scientific research awards such as the First Prize of the Scientific Research Outstanding Achievement Award of Colleges and Universities, and the Zhejiang Science and Technology Progress Award, published more than 60 papers in important journals at home and abroad, more than 30 papers included in SCI and EI, and authorized more than 30 Chinese invention patents and more than 40 utility patents.

duration.text: The Electrical Engineering at Wenzhou University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3055 USD/per year ￥ 22000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Graduation certificate of highest education level attained*Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.2.An official transcript from the college you have recently attended.* Official transcript should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.3.Two Recommendation letters ( only for Master applicant)4.Certificate of English proficiency test*IELTS or TOEFL will only be required if the applicant is not a native English speaker (A minimum score should be obtained as follows: IELTS 6.0, TOEFL iBT70, or TOEFL paper based 550 ）5.Applicants to Chinese programs must pass HSK grade 5 or above6.A photocopy of your passport.7.Bank statement (normally the balance is enough for your first year tuition fee and accommodation fee )8.No Criminal Report (if necessary)9.Health report ( within the validation period)10.Recommendation letters from two experts (assistant porfessors, associate professors, or professors)11.Self-introduction vedio12.Study Plan of no less than 1000 words.

requirements.text: 1.Non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport2.University graduate or equivalent to a Chinese University graduate (Master Degree Applicant)3.Be in good health condition and above the age of 18
